name: Eluder--Range Separation Class
definition: On coordinates $x_1,\ldots,x_5$, let $\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ER}}=\{00111,01000,01001,01111,10000,10010,10100,11111\}$, where the displayed bits are the values at $x_1,\ldots,x_5$ in that order.
comments: A finite counterexample to the candidate inequality $\mathrm{Edim}\geq\mathrm R^p$.
